zh-CN: 汇总正式版 4.6.5 之后的界面维护：扫描/入库操作分行对齐，仓库活跃度固定显示最近 20 周，手动库存备注可选，MCP 概览默认精简。
补齐中英文状态和弹窗文案并保护用户填写的内容；首次启动按 Windows 界面语言选择中文或 English，可在引导第一步即时切换并保存。
未变化且已验证的发行包可复用完整性缓存；首次启动、升级或文件变化仍执行全量校验。
用户资料与仓库格式保持兼容，无需迁移。
en-US: Summarizes UI maintenance since stable 4.6.5: aligned Workbench actions, a fixed latest-20-week activity chart, optional manual notes and compact MCP insights.
Completes bilingual status and dialog copy while preserving user text; choose Chinese or English on first launch and switch in the first onboarding step.
Reuse integrity verification for an unchanged, verified distribution; first launch, upgrades and changed files still receive full checks.
Warehouse format and user data remain compatible; no migration is required.
